# Bundled CPython runtime notices

These original license files and `PYTHON.json` were extracted unchanged from
[Astral's CPython 3.12.14 / 20260924 / aarch64 macOS full build](https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/tag/20260924).

Archive: `cpython-3.12.14+20260924-aarch64-apple-darwin-pgo+lto-full.tar.zst`

Upstream published and locally verified SHA-256:
`0bcd6620de677cb12e19a987ab78603267d4c1173ed72ba082a91fe85ac36959`

The desktop packager retains the complete upstream license directory, including
CPython, OpenSSL and other native dependency notices. `PYTHON.json` records the
build's extension-level license metadata. Some files cover other platforms; all
upstream materials are retained together. The packager checks the installed
runtime's `BUILD` against this release before redistributing it. The runtime is
installed by uv; this source inventory does not claim byte identity after
installation or signing. Keep these materials under their original licenses.
